The stimulus tick is a 4px-wide bar. The smallest scale step (4px) would round it into a circle and destroy the tick shape; 1px is a hairline softening, not a corner style.
The status dot inside the Out Loud chip is a circle. 50% is how a circle is expressed; it is not a point on a corner-radius scale.
